ShellCoast_Text_Npc0.en: The shells sing at night. If you\nlisten, you hear your name.
ShellCoast_Text_Npc0.fr: Les coquillages chantent la nuit.\nSi tu écoutes, tu entends ton nom.

ShellCoast_Text_Npc1.en: FEEBAS hides in plain water.\nPatience, always patience.
ShellCoast_Text_Npc1.fr: BARPAU se cache dans l'eau simple.\nDe la patience, toujours de la\lpatience.

ShellCoast_Text_Quest0_AfterT.en: The coast is a lovely place.
ShellCoast_Text_Quest0_AfterT.fr: La côte est un endroit charmant.

ShellCoast_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: A cold LEMONADE for my seashell\nstand. I will trade you a rare\ptooth.
ShellCoast_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Une LIMONADE fraîche pour mon stand\nde coquillages. Je t'échange une\ldent rare.

ShellCoast_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
ShellCoast_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

ShellCoast_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

ShellCoast_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
ShellCoast_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
